program.name: Floor Marathon
program.subject: Bodyweight
program.blurb: Two long bodyweight circuits a day, for stamina as much as strength.
program.about: A long session on the floor, no gear at all. Each day is two circuits, the first of push, legs, pull and core, the second of single-leg work, glutes and conditioning, round after round. Two days alternate. Abs finish every session. Both later levels add reps.
program.split: Two long circuits a day, A / B, no gear
